$comment: All durable harness state, owned by the CLI (./AGENTS.sh) — never hand-edit. Keys: setup (present only while guided setup is pending; init drives it), commands (via `cmd set/rm`; verify = definition-of-done step, init = session-start check), features (via `feature ...`; max one in_progress, never delete — mark done), progress (via `log`; append-only, display bounded by the CLI), rules (via `docs add/rm`; curated project knowledge). Future harness versions may add top-level keys. Transient scratch lives in agents.scratch.json (gitignored).

rules.text: Audio: mic -> AudioWorklet (4096 PCM) -> Web Worker (src/audio/worker.js) -> KeyDetector. Detectors in src/detection/specifics/, registered in src/detection/factory.js, lazy-loaded.
Detection result contract: { tonic, mode, score, confidence, alternate, chroma }; mode is 'major'|'minor' only.
Profile matching: src/detection/profile-matching.js — Krumhansl-Schmuckler major/minor, Pearson, common-session-key boost. 24 candidates.
Modes = major/minor only. No dorian/mixolydian/etc — that complexity killed bourdon.
Large binaries (WAV, ONNX) never in repo; host on Cloudflare R2 (r2-assets.json + README). No Git LFS.
Never test via vite dev; always npm run build + serve dist/ (npm run preview). playwright.config.js webServer enforces this.
Benchmark ground truth = abc/ filenames; modal tunes map by third: lydian/mixolydian->major, dorian/phrygian->minor.
e2e chromium auto-installed by init cmd 'browsers' (npx playwright install chromium). Fake mic via launch flags in playwright.config.js.

R2 base URL: https://r2-fiddlekey.bysander.net. Agents have NO R2 credentials; never script uploads. New large asset: script to fetch/generate it + name suggestion + r2-assets.json entry, then ask human to upload.
